domainSeparation.authorizationDependency: Existing app-wide fish role helpers are reused only for reviewer/admin/crawler authorization.

tables.name: marine_organisms
tables.purpose: Canonical Marine Organism identity and publication state

tables.name: marine_organism_source_records
tables.purpose: Versioned source evidence in an independent domain registry

tables.name: marine_organism_sources
tables.purpose: Canonical-to-source relation with field precedence and lineage

tables.name: marine_organism_aliases
tables.purpose: Reviewed common, regional, historic, English, and scientific aliases

tables.name: marine_organism_slug_aliases
tables.purpose: Redirect continuity for immutable canonical slugs

identity.primaryKey: Deterministic UUIDv5 generated from the Marine Organism namespace and MBRIS internal ID.
identity.slug: Deterministic lowercase ASCII kebab-case from canonical scientific name; immutable and unique within this domain.
identity.crossDomainPolicy: Documented overlap is permitted because Fish and Marine Organism have separate UUID, table, and route slug namespaces.

sourceStrategy.reason: It reuses stable provider/source identity without coupling Fish and Marine Organism row lifecycles or FKs.
sourceStrategy.commonRegistryFutureOption: A neutral shared source registry may be introduced only through a separately reviewed migration.

koreanNamePolicy.reason: V1 product identity and Korean UX require a sourced Korean name; inferred translation is forbidden.

rls.public: Only published + approved + non-archived canonical rows and approved active aliases.
rls.reviewer: Read domain evidence and update review_status only.
rls.admin: Policies are prepared; broad mutations remain server-side/service credential operations.

auditStrategy.reason: SECURITY DEFINER audit functions require an independent ACL and metadata-only review.
auditStrategy.requiredAcl: Revoke EXECUTE from PUBLIC, anon, and authenticated before granting the dedicated auditor.
